digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge reconciler CLI and engine
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must run one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass without launching reconcile-check or duplicating a comparison pass.
Canonical bridge preview must acquire, purge, steal, and write no pass lock; collateral repository and ref state must remain byte-identical.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, output, and exit behavior unchanged.
The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False so that abbreviated or unknown options exit 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally while legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain the historical tally/no-retained-manifest contract.
Legacy uncapped LIVE through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, older workflows, and external helpers must retain the historical tally/no-retained-manifest surface contract unchanged.
